event.description: Test rank7 positions with zero weight decay
event.proposal: family: position representation; current retained incumbent is 2884 parameters at 99.9900%, a +0.99 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0050, rank8 factorized positions under zero weight decay at 2884/99.99%; same-family failed result: attempt-0048, rank9 positions with standard decay at 2933/97.30% (and the older rank8 factor was 0.11%); prior attempts in this family: 8. Hypothesis: zero weight decay rescued rank9 and rank8, so continue the ordered rank sweep one step to rank7, reducing the position representation by another 49 parameters to about 2835 while keeping every position index and the same successful optimizer. This is more informative than switching to row tying or a deterministic basis because it preserves the factorized representation family and tests the next capacity boundary; the nearest untested alternative is rank6, which would skip this local interpolation. Keep d14/h2/L2, MQA, independent head-local maps, ff23, affine-free block pre-norms, final learned scale without bias, reversed operands, mixed-digit curriculum, zero weight decay, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 2884 parameters.
